changes: Fits stay connected to their data: a chip shows Up to date, Out of date, Auto or Stalled; Update fits again into the same columns, Keep updated does it by itself, and Change parameters reopens the Fit window on the fit.
A fit's columns are protected: typing over them offers Detach, and deleting one asks whether the whole fit goes.
The Fit window is a window of its own: move it beside the graph or onto a second screen.
Shift+click in Objects selects every plot between two rows.
A fit that gets stuck now says Stalled instead of Converged, and weighted R² uses the weighted mean.
The Assistant finds Claude Code and Codex where their apps install them, with a settings card for the chosen agent.
Coming from Patina Plot 0.1.x: it is now Vellum Plot (0.2.0), with the Assistant; your projects, settings and templates come along.
